description: A thin overlay: the image, its base images, the CLI pin and the linters live in the upstream/ submodule and are updated there under upstream's own policy. The dependencies here are the submodule pin and the workflow's actions.

packageRules.description: An upstream bump is a new image build and a container recreate on deploy, which drops Remote Control and may need a /login. A person merges it when at a keyboard; validate refuses a pin that is not a release tag.
